question: What does FENCE.I synchronize between instruction-memory writes and instruction fetches on one hart?

facts.description: FENCE.I synchronizes instruction-memory writes and instruction fetches on the same hart.

development_reason: The live evaluation exposed promotion of SPEC intent to COMPARISON; this case informed the intent policy fix.

question: In the pc_adder RTL, is the next sequential address named next_pc or PCPlus4, and how is it calculated?

facts.description: The output is PCPlus4; this does not prove next_pc absent from the whole design.

development_reason: The live evaluation exposed promotion of RTL intent to COMPARISON; this case informed the intent policy fix.
